testcase.name: Scenario: Navigate the origin branch with arrow keys: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-model-browser-source/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:276:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Navigate the origin branch with arrow keys ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part with a visible block is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the Origin branch is expanded with its origin planes hidden ✔ When the user selects the YZ Plane row in the model browser ✔ Then the YZ plane is highlighted in the viewport ✔ When the user presses Down Arrow ✔ Then the XZ Plane row is selected and the XZ plane is highlighted ✔ And the YZ plane highlight is removed ✔ When the user presses Up Arrow ✔ Then the YZ Plane row is selected and the YZ plane is highlighted again ✔ When the user presses Left Arrow ✔ Then the Origin parent row is selected and the plane highlight is removed ✔ When the user presses Left Arrow again ✔ Then the Origin branch collapses and its children are hidden ✔ When the user presses Right Arrow ✔ Then the Origin branch expands and its children are visible ✔ When the user presses Right Arrow again ✔ Then the YZ Plane row is selected and the YZ plane is highlighted ✔ When the user clicks empty viewport space ✔ Then the plane highlight disappears and the block remains visible
